description: Medical.Net command-line tool: clinical scores and calculators, terminology search, drug safety, FHIR (patient, IPS, profile validation), SATUSEHAT workflow bundles, BPJS INA-CBG claims, HL7 v2 (orders, scheduling, documents, conformance, MLLP send/listen), DICOM (phantom, info, render, anonymize, echo), ECG analysis, de-identification, decision support, risk models, the AI clinical assistant, critical-care and cardiovascular scores, WHO growth, organ dosing, clinical NLP with ICD-10 suggestions, cited guideline answers, federated learning and drift monitoring, plus the v2.0 hospital platform: a seeded multi-tenant HIS (dashboard, patient lookup with FHIR summary), simulated ICU monitors feeding real-time NEWS2 alerts, and an offline-first sync walkthrough. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
